description: WPF rebuilt from the MIT sources of dotnet/wpf, running everywhere .NET runs: Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS and the browser (WebAssembly). The same XAML, controls and data binding, with the native Windows parts replaced by managed code on SystemDrawing-NT. Use it as the project SDK (Sdk="WPF-NT/1.0.0-preview.1"), also in place of Microsoft.NET.Sdk in an existing WPF project; class libraries can reference it as a package. WPF-NT commit 96502657c5f3e63f325a5efdc1d37a91f5437220; iOS backend compiled on Linux against the Microsoft.iOS reference assembly; no Windows Forms (winforms-nt) in this build.
releaseNotes: See https://wpf-nt.org for the release notes.
title: WPF-NT
